headline: Wall Street Volatility Surges as Retail Traders Exit Amid Market Rout
summary: Market volatility spiked as retail traders sold holdings, systematic funds prepared large sales, and confidence in technology stocks weakened.
why: Surging volatility indices reflect heightened investor fear and defensive positioning across global equity markets, particularly in high-flying tech sectors.

impacts.name: CBOE Volatility Index
impacts.why: Selling pressure and portfolio protection hedging directly drive up market fear gauges and volatility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broad market rout and retreating retail participation triggered heavy selling and portfolio hedging, sending volatility gauges soaring.
